en.selectedTitle: 🎄 Raven's Secret Christmas Menu | Christmas Special #4 #Shorts
en.description: On the fourth day of our Christmas Special, Mom Raven gathers the whole family to decide the delicious dishes for our magical dinner!

text.pt: A cozinha da Casa Azul está perfumada, pois hoje Mamãe Raven planeja a ceia perfeita.
text.en: The Blue House kitchen smells amazing because today Mom Raven is planning the perfect dinner.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Raven, a black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a colorful floral print dress, sits at a wooden table with a notebook. The kitchen is decorated with golden Christmas lights and garlands.

text.pt: Crianças e Vlad, venham aqui para escolhermos as receitas mágicas da nossa grande ceia natalina.
text.en: Children and Vlad, come here so we can choose the magical recipes for our grand Christmas dinner.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Theo, a cream orange Pomeranian dog wearing rainbow multicolored frame glasses and a blue button-down shirt, stands excitedly near the kitchen counter decorated with ornaments.

text.pt: Eu voto em fazermos uma sobremesa bem colorida que brilhe tanto quanto as luzes da árvore.
text.en: I vote for making a very colorful dessert that shines as much as the tree lights.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Jonny, a cream golden Pomeranian dog with no glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie, looks up with big eyes in the decorated kitchen.

text.pt: Por favor, não esqueçam dos biscoitos crocantes que o Papai Noel sempre gosta de comer.
text.en: Please, do not forget the crunchy cookies that Santa Claus always likes to eat.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Luna, a black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse, holds a tablet showing food photos next to a Christmas garland.

text.pt: Podemos incluir pratos modernos e saudáveis para deixar nossa mesa ainda mais bonita e equilibrada.
text.en: We can include modern and healthy dishes to make our table even more beautiful and balanced.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Vlad, a cream golden-white Pomeranian dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie, smiling in the kitchen.

text.pt: Eu cuido do assado principal para garantir que teremos aquele banquete tradicional que todos amamos.
text.en: I will handle the main roast to ensure we have that traditional feast we all love.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Raven, the black Pomeranian, writing enthusiastically in her recipe book. Close-up on her face and glasses with Christmas reflections.

text.pt: Estou anotando tudo no meu caderno de receitas para que nada seja esquecido nessa noite especial.
text.en: I am writing everything down in my recipe book so nothing is forgotten on this special night.

scenes.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 fotorrealistic Pixar 3D style. Jonny, the small cream Pomeranian, jumping happily in the kitchen surrounded by festive decorations and family members' legs visible.

text.pt: Planejar o cardápio com vocês é quase tão divertido quanto abrir os presentes na manhã seguinte.
text.en: Planning the menu with you is almost as fun as opening presents the next morning.

text.pt: Nosso Natal será inesquecível e cheio de amor com a nossa família reunida nesta noite mágica.
text.en: Our Christmas will be unforgettable and full of love with our family gathered on this magic night.

en: A new holiday story every day!
